error.message: Failed to set preferences: unknown error

observed: The R8 runner created its persistent Firefox profile under the host /tmp directory. The installed Firefox is a strict-confined Snap and could not initialize that external profile path.
inference: The failure is in browser-profile visibility before any R8 page, SDK artifact, Service Worker, or cache probe runs.
verifiedRemediation: A Firefox WebDriver session using the same preferences starts successfully when the temporary profile directory is under the project path in /home; the directory is removed after close.
